senses.definition: adj. glorious, only fs. כְּבוּדָּ֯ה, of a bed Ez 23:41; a queen in bridal array ψ 45:14; ψ 45:14 belongs to II. כָּבוֹד 2; cstr. as Ges§ 141 d; v. also כֹּל 1 a end. cf. כְּבוּדָּ֯ה n.f. infr.
